data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 站台上的消息
data.description: 列车还没到站，雪菜看了一眼手机里的消息，抬头望向轨道另一端。
data.action: holding a phone and looking down the tracks
data.promptProse: Standing near the yellow safety line on a chilly train platform at dusk, Setsuna clutches her mobile phone to her chest, looking anxiously down the empty tracks into the winter mist. Cold halogen platform lamps buzz overhead, illuminating vapor puffs from her breath, a glowing station clock, and her red woolen scarf fluttering in the arriving train breeze.
